name: TDspSF2
description: General-MIDI sampled-instrument engine for Teensy 4.1. Drives a pool of AudioSynthWavetable voices (Teensy Audio Library) from GM MIDI, loading real SF2 instruments at runtime into PSRAM via manicken/sf22aswt (vendored under src/sf22aswt, MIT). Adds the GM layer sf22aswt lacks: program/bank -> SF2-instrument resolution (phdr/pbag/pgen), a voice allocator, per-channel program + pitch bend, drums on channel 10, and a PSRAM-adaptive resident-instrument cache (8 MB / 16 MB auto). Slots behind the same tdsp::MidiSink seam as the Dexed/OPL3/OPM backends.
